content: Sase taambɗiɗ Yeesu
Wa Yeesu ree Yeriko, a lahha ŋ ɗooƴ kur ka, a kaɗeeɗa.
Wa raakeen ƴaar teeku Sase, a yi nikee kilifaanaŋ juuti'oh ca, te a raakeen lool.
A markeeɗa ne a hot ya ɓa Yeesu, waaye a mineeɗi wa sagu rohƴa a rohƴee na mboolnda.
A nuppa ŋ fikiira, a rappa ŋ ɗafuk ndun ŋ waasa ne a hot Yeesu, ne yeem taambee ɗah.
Wa Yeesu hay po a reesa ndaam, a taaknukka, a woosa ɗe ne : « Sase ara ruhus, woti ŋ joy dal ŋ kahan fu. »
A arra ruhus, a daliɗta Yeesu ŋ kahan ce, a neɓuusa nga lool.
Wa ɓooɓa hot ineem, ɓa jen ɓa lahtukeeɗa ne : « Markaat ƴaari, a dal ŋ kahan bakaaɗoh. »
Raak Sase tufkiɗ, woyeeɗa Yeesu ne : « Kilifaani, ŋ hey eɗe ñakiɗ ci ɓaki winooriŋ raak-raakiŋ ngo. Te ɓo' nu nik ne ŋ kooɗiɗ in uupiɗ nga ɗe ɗah, ŋ hey ɗe wa dokne waas nikiis. »
Yeesu woosa ne : « Muci reyiɗ ŋ kahnii woti. Ƴaarii nam ɓaah keeh-keeh ŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima.
Te Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hayiɗ ne a waak muuƴiɗ ci, a hirip ɓa. »
Hanjar ca ndaŋkiyaah ca urus ca
Ɓooɓa nikee sikɗukeeɗa Yeesu. Raak ɗe ŋ ɓak Yerusalem te ɓooɓi liiɓee ne Nguuriŋ-Kooh na hee hotke win-win.
Ŋ ineem Yeesu woosa ɓa ŋ andiin ne : « A nikee garmi, a joyya kaɗ kur usiɗ ne a ɓekohsa buur nga, ƴut ɗah, a dokuk kur ce.
Bala a kaɗan ɗah, a ɓeeɗukka ñaam ndaŋkiyaah ŋ ɓaŋ ɗe, a eɗta yaa nu nga ɗah hanjar urus, a woosa ɓa ne : “ Toontukaat po ŋ hay. ”
Wa a na kaɗe jen, ɓi kur ce waaɗeeɗi ɗe, ɓa tuuƴca ɓi ɓo' ŋ finhooce ne ɓa ree ɗah, ɓa woo ne ɓa waaɗɗi ne a nik buuriŋ ɓa.
Hondohɗi, a tumuusa buur. A hayissa, a ɓeeɗukka ñaam ca a eɗe kopora ne a marak ini ɓa ɓaat nga.
Ya koc hayya woosa ɗe ne : “ Kilifaani, ursiŋ ɗa fu eɗee so eɗohiɗ hanjar urus ndaŋkiyaah. ”
Buura loffa ɗe ne : “ Corka ! Fu ñaam baahiɗ, findi fu ndengɗukoh ŋ in ci ƴin ci, tahiɗ po adgoha kur ndaŋkiyaah. ”
Ya kanakɗoh hayya woosa ɗe ne : “ Kilifaani, ursiŋ ɗa fu eɗee so eɗohiɗ hanjar urus yatuus. ”
Buura woosa ɗe ne : “ Nama adgoh kur yatuus. ”
Ñaam wiiriis hayya, woosa ɗe ne : “ Kilifaani, fu ɓo' miskiɗ ; fu na kooɗe ini fu raakɗi te fu na nguɗe ini fu sokɗi. Ineem weɗ tah po ŋ neƴƴohha ɗa, ŋ loƴca ursiŋ ɗa, ŋ ɗaakkaa. ”
Buura loffa ɗe ne : “ Ñaami baahaaɗiini, ŋ atte'an ɗa ngaŋ in ci fu woo. Fu inheen ne ŋ ɓo' miskiɗ, mi na kooɗe ini ŋ raakɗi, ŋ nguɗe ini ŋ sokɗi.
Wa ye tah fu ɗaakɗi koporiŋ ngo ŋ ɗiska na ɗaakohse kopor, ne ŋ hay ɗah, ŋ raaka rimɗiɗ to in ? ”
Ƴutta, a woosa ƴaaɓa nikee nga ne : “ Ɓayaat ursi nik na ɗe, ɗu eɗa yi raak hanjar urus ndaŋkiyaah. ”
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne : “ Moo Kilifaani, ƴaareem raakiɗ hanjar ndaŋkiyaah ! ”
A loffa ɓa ne : “ Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ɓoyi raak hey ɓaatse, waaye ɓoyi raakɗi, ini ƴissuuti a amb sah hey naafse nga ɗe.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓi sang ngo, ɓi waaɗeeɗi ne ŋ nik buuriŋ ɓa, hayaat na ɓa ndii, ɗu ap ɓa ŋ fikiiso. ” »
Wa Yeesu ƴut ŋ woo ceem, a adgiɗta ɓa ne ɓa kaɗ Yerusalem.
Aasaŋ Yeesu ŋ Yerusalem
Wa Yeesu kaɗ po a heeɗa ree Betfase na Betani ŋ sero tangoora na woyse Tangooraŋ-Oliiw-ca, a woossa taalube kanak.
A woosa ɓa ne : « Kaɗaat ŋ kur ki ŋ fikiiɗu wii, ɗu ree ɗah, ɗu hey raake cumbur mbaam tokuuɗ nga, yi ali ɓo' moosɗi rapoh. Toksaat ɗe, ɗu hay na ɗe ndii.
Ɓo' meekis ɗu wa ye tah ɗu toksee ɗe ɗah, woyaat ɗe ne a kilifaani etoh ɗe. »
Wa ɓooɓa woossee kaɗ, ɓa raakohha in ceem ɗaa, findi Yeesu woyohee ɓa.
Ɓa tokseeɗa cumbra, ɓooɓa raak ɗe woosa ɓa ne : « Wa ye tah ɗu tokse cumbri ? »
Ɓa loffa ɓa ne : « A kilifaani etoh ɗe. »
Ɓa kommba Yeesu ɗe, ɓa raɗta kulɓaacaŋ ɓa ŋ ɗafuk cumbra, ɓa rapiɗta Yeesu nga ɗe.
A kaɗeeɗa, ɓooɓa raɗɗeeɗa ɗe kulɓaacaŋ ɓa ŋ waasa.
Wa a hay po a heeɗa ruhse Tangooraŋ-Oliiw-ca ŋ ɓak Yerusalem, taalubeeciŋ ɗe findi ɓa hend jen, ɓa neɓuusa, ɓa cammba ƴeek Kooh ŋ ɗafka sagu keemaan ca laayiɗ ca fu inah ne ɓa hoteen ca.
Ɓa woyeeɗa ne :

content.text: « Buuri na haye ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi,
ndami nikaat nik na Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka. »

content: Ɓi Farisen nikeen ŋ ɗooƴ mboolnda, ɓa woosa Yeesu ne : « Jangɗohohi, woytoha taalubeeciŋ ɗa. »
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne : « Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ɓa ɗek ɗah, e atoh ci ƴeekan. »
Yeesu fuɗiɗ Yerusalem
Wa Yeesu kaɗ po a yurhiɗkohha na Yerusalem, wa misikka ɗe, a fuɗtaa.
An : « Na ɗa, fu inheen woti in ci min ɗa kom jam ɗah ! Waaye, ɗiski wa nik ndii fu minɗi ca hot.
Jamano miskiɗ hey haye nga ɗa, ɓi sang ɗa hey tufkiɗe miir wiiriis wa wil wiŋ ɗa, ɓa ndeer ɗa, ɓa keen ɗa ŋ ɓak ci jen,
ɓa ɗumb ɗa na ɓooɓiŋ ɗa. Ɓa heyɗi ɗa faɗɗe ali atoh kanak degsukohiɗ. Laam fu inhisohɗi jamanooni Kooh hayoh ɗa hirpe. »
Yeesu ŋ Kahan Kooh
Wa Yeesu ree Yerusalem, a aassa Kahan Kooh, a aañeeɗa toonoh ca.
A woyeeɗa ɓa ne : « Kooh woyiɗ ŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci ne : “ Kahan ndo nikaat kahan kiimohaa so ”, waaye ɗu tumiɗa ɗembohaaniŋ rokoh ci. »
Mbeh nu nik a meeɗta jangɗoh ŋ Kahan Kooh. Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa, na jangɗohoh caŋ wa, na yakak ca waakeeɗa findi ɓa apohan ɗe.
Waaye ɓa inahɗi findi ɓa tuman laam ɓooɓa jen nikee ñaakiɗ nga ɗe, ɓa sikɗukeeɗa ɗe.
